edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits the allowance of msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender is forwarded as an argument into the external receiveApproval call.
transferOwnership writes the staged address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Token constructor sets symbol.
Token constructor sets name.
Token constructor sets decimals.
Token constructor sets the total supply.
Token constructor credits the full supply to the fixed holder address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn adjustment.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer rewrites both the sender and recipient balance entries.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom rewrites the from and to balance entries.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs the external callback to spender after writing allowance state.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary tokenAddress supplied by the owner.
safeAdd performs the addition and the overflow require check.
safeSub performs the subtraction and the underflow require check.
safeMul performs the multiplication and the overflow require check.
safeDiv performs the division and the zero-divisor require check.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
to parameter is used as the credit target of transfer.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transfer.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
spender parameter keys the allowance written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the callback target.
tokens parameter is the allowance value set by approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary contract that is called.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external token transfer.
_newOwner parameter is stored as the pending owner.
tokenOwner parameter keys the balance read in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance read.
spender parameter keys the allowance read.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to of transfer has no independent semantics; collapse into the transfer function node.
Parameter tokens of transfer only carries the amount; collapse into the transfer function node.
Parameter from of transferFrom is a transient account reference; collapse into transferFrom.
Parameter to of transferFrom is a transient account reference; collapse into transferFrom.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom is a transient amount; collapse into transferFrom.
Parameter spender of approve only keys the allowance mapping; collapse into approve.
Parameter tokens of approve only carries the allowance amount; collapse into approve.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall is the callback target; collapse into approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall only carries the allowance amount; collapse into approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded to the external callback; collapse into approveAndCall.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token selects the external callee; collapse into the function.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token only carries the amount; collapse into the function.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership is stored directly; collapse into transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf only keys the balances mapping read; collapse into balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance only keys the allowed mapping read; collapse into allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance only keys the allowed mapping read; collapse into allowance.
